title: The Stigma Cycle
description: Interactive causal loop diagram of the six-stage ADHD stigma cycle with clickable stages, example dialogue, and two break-point nodes that cut the loop and explain what changes downstream.
creator: Arun Batchu
subject: ADHD
Stigma
Self-Stigma
Systems Thinking
audience: People with ADHD, Family members, Students, Educators

controls.label: Loop stages
controls.purpose: Show each stage's example and how it feeds the next

controls.label: Break points
controls.purpose: Cut the edge that break point interrupts; click again to restore
